title: Tanbeeh: Revolutionizing Safety and Efficiency with AI
summary: DP World reports that Tanbeeh reduced gate entry from three minutes to 15 seconds. The platform also monitors fire and protective equipment; prevented injuries are unproven.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: DP World reports that Tanbeeh reduced gate entry from three minutes to 15 seconds. The platform also monitors fire and protective equipment; prevented injuries are unproven. The source alternates between PPE detection accuracy and compliance, and gives varying fire-detection times. The proposed depth rests on its clearer gate-entry time comparison.
purpose: Automate industrial access control and safety monitoring.
location: DP World industrial facilities; particular site unspecified

ratings.reason: DP World reports that gate entry fell from three minutes to 15 seconds in live operations. The rating reflects this time saving, not the source's inconsistent PPE metric.
Greater worker safety is intended; the chapter does not measure injuries prevented.
Lower congestion emissions and fewer harmful fires are intended, with no measured public outcome.

ai_role.statement: Computer vision supports gate authentication and safety monitoring. The time-saving rating rests on gate processing; a model-triggered prevention of injury is not established.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: Tanbeeh: Revolutionizing Safety and Efficiency with AI

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: On-premises CCTV feeds and a high-bandwidth local network
Locally adapted vision models and operational staff

headline: Tanbeeh speeds gate entry at DP World

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
